about.title: About me
about.description: I am a motivated and detail-oriented student from Sri Lanka with a strong interest in programming, web development, and software engineering. I have studied at St. Joseph's College, Colombo 10, as well as Yoga Elementary School and Yoga Junior High School in Tokyo, Japan. Currently, I am attending Toda Higashi Junior High School in Saitama prefecture in Japan. I am particularly passionate about building websites and expanding my technical skill set. Being multilingual, with proficiency in English, Sinhala, and Japanese, allows me to communicate effectively in diverse environments. I am eager to further develop my skills in Python programming and pursue CCNA certification as I continue to grow in the field of technology.

comintro.title: What is
comintro.description: DOALM 7 is a technology company that I aspire to establish in the future. I am highly ambitious and believe in achieving success through teamwork rather than individual accomplishment. Although DOALM 7 is still in its conceptual stage, my goal is to develop it into a successful and impactful technology-driven organization. The name DOALM 7 carries a deeper meaning. The number seven symbolizes completeness, a concept rooted in biblical tradition. This represents my vision for the company—to build solutions that are complete, efficient, and meaningful. Through DOALM 7, I aim to contribute positively to the technology sector while fostering collaboration, innovation, and excellence.
